description: Every ComfyUI workflow JSON published on Comfy with ComfyUI (CC0), with the articles that explain it. Japanese articles are the source of truth. Workflow files are the ComfyUI UI format (open or drag into ComfyUI). models_source tells where the model list comes from: loaders (the workflow's own properties.models, plus any model file its Markdown note links that no loader lists; those are often alternatives, such as GGUF versions), note (only links in its note), names_only (only the file names its loaders ask for; find them through the article), or none (it picks no model file; a custom node may still download its own). Each model's source says the same per model (loaders, note, or null for a bare file name). A model with directory null does not say which models/ folder it belongs in. updated is the last day the workflow's build changed (YYYY-MM-DD); filling in model or custom node metadata does not move it.
